action_timeline.action: Decide on The Peninsula Shanghai 'A Gift for the New Year' direct offer (15% off rooms + breakfast for 2 + 6am/10pm Peninsula Time; non-refundable) OR lock a Free-Cancellation rate at Langham / Shangri-La / Sukhothai.

If flying US ↔ Shanghai round-trip without a 3rd country/region, submit COVA L-Visa application before the $140/person reduced US fee expires Dec 31, 2026 (no flights or hotel bookings required for US L-visa!).
Book flagship tasting-menu seats: Taian Table (3★, RMB 2,000/pp deposit, free cancel ≥6 days prior), Da Vittorio (2★), 8½ Otto e Mezzo Bombana (2★), Fu He Hui (2★), and Bao Li Xuan (2★).
Re-price your refundable Feb 15–22 hotel booking before Feb 13–15, 2027 free-cancellation cutoffs, and check Shanghai Disneyland Feb 2027 daily tier calendar + Yu Garden Lantern Festival notice.
